faqs.question: What should a real estate brochure include?
faqs.answer: The project name and locality, RERA registration number and authority website, configurations and possession timeline, a location map with real distances, floor plans with carpet area, amenities in the approved plan, specifications, the developer's background, a clear next step such as a WhatsApp number, and a disclaimer.

faqs.question: How should a real estate brochure be structured?
faqs.answer: In the order buyers ask questions: cover, the project at a glance, location, floor plans, amenities, specifications, the developer, and a clear call to visit. Long brochures benefit from a one-page summary at the front, which sales teams can also send as a single image on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: What are the best real estate brochure design tips?
faqs.answer: Keep one idea per spread, use real photos and label renders as artistic impressions, make body text readable on a phone, use the same colours and fonts as your ads and hoardings, make numbers big and adjectives small, and write specifications in plain words a buyer would use.

faqs.question: Does a brochure need a RERA number?
faqs.answer: Yes. Section 11(2) of the RERA Act requires every advertisement or prospectus to carry the project's registration number and the website address of the state authority. Put both on the cover and with the disclaimer, and make sure the price sheet sent with the brochure carries them too.

faqs.question: Which area should brochure floor plans show?
faqs.answer: Lead with carpet area, which the RERA Act defines and on which apartments are sold under RERA. If you also show built-up or super built-up area, label each figure clearly, add room dimensions, mark furniture as indicative and include a key plan showing the unit's position and facing.

faqs.question: How do I compress a real estate brochure PDF for WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Export a separate screen version from the design file with a small-file preset, downsample images, flatten heavy effects, then run a PDF optimiser and check that plans and the RERA number stay sharp. For automated sending, Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform allows PDF documents up to 100 MB.

faqs.question: What terms are used in Gujarati real estate brochures?
faqs.answer: Common terms are કાર્પેટ એરિયા (carpet area), સુપર બિલ્ટ-અપ એરિયા (super built-up area), પઝેશન or કબજો (possession), સુવિધાઓ (amenities), ચોરસ વાર (square yard), બી.યુ. પરમિશન (occupancy permission in Gujarat), દસ્તાવેજ (sale deed), જંત્રી (government valuation rate) and રેરા રજિસ્ટ્રેશન નંબર.

faqs.question: Should a brochure be translated into Hindi or Gujarati?
faqs.answer: Often yes, as a two-language brochure or a regional one-page summary. Translate the story and benefits fully, keep standard property terms in their familiar form in the local script, make every number match the English version, show the RERA number and state authority website, and have a native speaker proofread it.

faqs.question: How fast should the brochure be sent after an enquiry?
faqs.answer: Within minutes, ideally instantly. Buyers often enquire with several projects at once, and the first project to reply with the brochure, price sheet and a visit slot has the best chance of the visit. WhatsApp automation makes an instant reply possible day and night.
